Name: StarAmy's Bar and Cafe Furniture 1.6
Author: Ashrayne
Description:
[i][size=4]Presenting: StarAmy's [/size][/i][size=4][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15973/]Bar and Cafe Furniture[/url] , now updated to CP &  AT for full compatibility with SDV 1.6. Permission for port granted by StarAmy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23281/?tab=posts/]here[/url].

[/i][/size][size=4][i]Features:[/i][/size]
[list]
[*]14 decorative bar/cafe furniture and signs purchasable from Robin's shop. 
[*]The freestanding pieces can be placed both indoors and outdoors.
[*]Access all original StarAmy sprite recolors for the Tasting Tray & Wine and Cheese Platter items using Alternative Textures.
[*]Access this mod's furniture set from StarAmy's furniture catalogue if you have that installed (see optional mod requirements)
[/list][i]
[size=4]Recommended Pairings:[/size][/i][color=#f1f1f1]
[/color][list][*]Create even MORE beautiful & elaborate bakery/cafe/bar designs with these, StarAmy's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23281/]Bakery Displays[/url] , and Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18814/]H&W's Farmer's Market Furniture Suite[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9991/]H&W's Bakery and Cafe Furniture[/url] sets.
[*]Transform your bar or cafe into the centerpiece of your very own fully functional store or restaurant with HaPyke's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309/]Market Town[/url]
[*]Is making gold just a little bit too easy? Switch things up with variable demand and dynamic pricing using Paul Steele's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21414/]Ferngill Simple Economy[/url]
[/list]
[size=4]Serving Suggestions:[/size]
What are you going to serve in your new SDV bar or cafe? Here's some ideas!
[list]
[*]Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23651/]H&W's Freshly Baked[/url]
[*]Himetarts & Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18717/]H&W's Mixology 101[/url]
[*]Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22734/]Wildflour's Atelier Goods - Brewer[/url]
[*]Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22732/]Wildflour's Atelier Goods - Barista (Hot)[/url]
[*]Wildflour's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22731/]Wildflour's Atelier Goods - Barista (Cold)[/url]
[*]Hutchy's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20609/]Craft Brewing[/url]
[*]Stunky McDoo's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8684/]Grapes of Ferngill[/url]
[*]jfujii's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2607/]Tea Time[/url]
[/list]
Last but not least, no list of SDV modded drinks would be complete without the mother of all craft mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8256/]Raffadax Complete Production[/url]. This mod is not yet ready for 1.6, but if you should feel so inclined, swing on by the mod page or Discord channel to offer some words of encouragement to the entire team of coders and alpha testers tackling the mammoth task that is converting Raffadax to 1.6 compliant code. It won't be long until new and old players alike can once more take up the epic quest to craft the Divine Wines. :)

Downloads.Description: Download and extract into your Stardew Mods folder, along with all requirements. If you have StarAmy's furniture catalogue installed, this furniture set will appear in her catalogue instead of Robin's shop.
